cutPreview: Rectangular cut from one corner. The remaining strips are recorded separately.
csvHelp: Use YYYY-MM-DD dates, a bank reference and a rupee amount in either debit or credit. Import up to 500 lines per file.
matchHelp: Choose the recorded payment with the same bank, amount and direction. Matching leaves the bank balance unchanged.
yearHelp: Closing locks new invoices, purchase documents, expenses and payments dated on or before the selected year end. Later collections against old invoices remain available.
confirm: Type the selected end date (YYYY-MM-DD) to confirm
denied: Your role has read-only access here.
pro: Available on Pro and during trial
badHeader: Choose a CSV using the template headers.
badRow: Check the date, reference, debit and credit in row
tooMany: Choose a file with 1–500 rows, up to 1 MB.
